items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I did many things with her, including 'Sweet Lorraine,' 'Melancholy Baby,' 'Sweet Georgia Brown.' ... That was with Kay Starr; that was before she became a big name.

ctx.x: I'm looking at that here. Then Kay Starr, I did many things with her, including "Sweet Lorraine," "Melancholy Baby," "Sweet Georgia Brown."
